sources.title: llama-3.3-70b-instruct Model by Meta | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: The Meta Llama 3.3 multilingual large language model (LLM) is a pretrained and instruction tuned generative model in 70B (text in/text out). The Llama 3.3 instruction-tuned text-only model is optimized for multilingual dialogue use cases and outperform many of the available open source and closed chat models on common industry benchmarks.

sources.snippet: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct is Meta's 70-billion parameter dense language model. NVIDIA provides FP8 and FP4 quantized variants optimized for Hopper (H100/H200) and Blackwell (B200/GB200) GPUs.
